context: A 3-panel crossfilter dashboard (horizontal bar, multi-line, scatter) with 6 categories, 300 data points, ghost-context overlays, and a prominent reduced-motion toggle that switches transitions from 300ms to instant.
first_impression: The layout is clean and well within cognitive limits, but the line chart's 6 overlapping colored lines form a near-spaghetti tangle that is hard to parse without interaction.
what_works: Three views is a natural, manageable cognitive unit; ghost bars/lines preserve full-dataset context while filtered foreground stands out clearly. The 6-color Tol palette is perceptually distinct and colorblind-safe, and the bar chart reads immediately.
what_doesnt: The line chart stacks 6 simultaneously visible colored lines over 24 months with heavy overlap — at rest it reads as visual noise before any interaction disambiguates it. The scatter's 300 densely packed multi-colored dots are also hard to parse categorically at a glance; animation/interaction quality (crosshair, brush, reduced-motion behavior) cannot be assessed from the static screenshot.
